column1: # CIRIS evidence registry — impl: tier (CIRISServer#327 / CIRISConstitution#17)
# Server's evidence rows. GENERATED from src/field_conformance.rs —
# SERVER_FIELD_CONFORMANCE (manifest-field processors, the CLM-nsproc-* family)
# plus SERVER_CLAIM_EVIDENCE (claims with a live symbol and no manifest field).
# Kept in sync with the code by field_conformance::evidence_tsv_matches_emitted —
# a drift is a build failure. Vendored by CIRISConstitution/tools/check_claims.py.
# Columns (the HEADER ROW below is emitted as data — CIRISServer#352):
#   decimal_id <TAB> claim_id <TAB> repo <TAB> path#symbol <TAB> crate@version
#          crate@version == "open" marks a DECLARED GAP (see below).
decimal_id
# Controls the Constitution attributes to this repo that are NOT enforced here.
# Stated as rows so silence cannot be read as coverage. Each points at a tracked
# issue and carries "open" in the version column, which check_claims.py reads as
# unresolved.
# All four are currently `established` in claims.tsv on the strength of
# `impl:CIRISServer#155`. #155 is CLOSED, and its title is "Evidence registry:
# expose a CC-section -> implementation-symbol map for the impl: tier" — the
# issue that asked for symbol-level evidence, cited as though it were that
# evidence. A pointer at an issue and a pointer at a symbol are not the same
# kind of object, and only one of them goes stale silently.
# ─── VERIFIED POINTERS AWAITING A CLAIM ID ─────────────────────────────────────
# Controls that ship in 0.5.152 with real, fail-closed enforcement and a
# production call site, for which CIRISConstitution defines no claim (checked
# against all 149 rows of claims.tsv). Listed as comments, not rows, because
# inventing a claim_id to make them resolvable is precisely the overclaim this
# registry guards against. Flip each to a live row the moment an id exists.
#   consent before scoring   src/peer.rs#emit_analyze_consent
#                            CIRISConstitution#46 is enforced by persist's
#                            check_capacity_consent_admission; this is the
#                            PRODUCER, and until 0.5.151 the in-fold path could
#                            not author it at all (240 peers consented to send,
#                            zero could consent to be scored)
#   in-fold consent path     src/federation_delivery.rs#author_consent_embedded
#                            authorised by the node being CLAIMED rather than by
#                            an HTTP session the fold cannot have; refuses on an
#                            unclaimed node
#   re-assertion coalescing  src/scorer.rs#coalesced_assertion
#                            persist #519 item 2a-iii's producer half — floors
#                            the assertion instant so repeated identical
#                            measurements sign byte-identical envelopes instead
#                            of accumulating ~10,000 live rows per agent
#   sample-size gate on wire src/scorer.rs#score_and_emit
#                            emits sample_size AND sample_size_gate in the
#                            envelope, so a gated zero is distinguishable from a
#                            measured zero by any reader (LC-AV-18)
#   default-prefix single-   src/peer.rs#default_attestation_prefixes
#   sourcing                 the production default is READ, never restated —
#                            a restated default forked for eight releases while
#                            zero traces moved
